name: Aerodrome
notes: Colored: the five stacked swooshes of the official favicon.svg unchanged (#0C0D1D, #0433FF, #9CADFF, #F5F3E6, #FF1100, each drawn over the previous one; the stylesheet classes became fill attributes), placed on the 64 grid
The brand kit's symbol.svg is the same mark but about 470 KB of path data (119 KB after SVGO), so the compact favicon.svg geometry is used

Mono: the same five paths in the same painting order inside a mask, so each stripe hides the ones it overlaps as in the colored mark, read by luminance: the dark #0C0D1D, #0433FF and #FF1100 stripes are full ink and the light #9CADFF and #F5F3E6 stripes 40% ink (mask fill #666); one solid colour would merge all five into a blob
